notes.sowing: Start indoors 5 to 7 weeks before planting out, {cm:1.3} deep at {c:12} to {c:22}. Plant out 1 to 2 weeks before your last frost, before seedlings get root-bound. Any check to growth gives small, early heads.
notes.care: Keep the soil evenly moist and the plants growing steadily. Heads form best when days average {c:10} to {c:21}. Once a head shows, tie the outer leaves over white types to keep the curd pale.
notes.harvest: Cut while the head is firm and tight, before it loosens or yellows. Heads go over within days, so check often.
